**Pizza:** The slices are small, roughly 10-12 cm long. Each is about 60-70 g, so three slices come to about 190 g. At roughly 270 kcal per 100 g, that is about 510 kcal.

**Salad:** The romaine is dressed with a creamy Caesar dressing. I estimate about 120 g, which at roughly 100 kcal per 100 g is about 120 kcal. There are no visible croutons.

**Total:** about 310 g of food and about 630 kcal.
